channel.title: RivianTrackr
channel.description: Independent Rivian coverage by an owner, for owners

item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
Rivian's upcoming 2026.41 software update for Gen 1 R1, Gen 2 R1 and R2 adds more road incidents to navigation, like lane closures, objects in the road, traffic lights and stop signs, plus the option to switch to an alternate route without leaving active navigation. Every model also gets a new Night theme and live sports scores through Rivian Assistant, while R2 picks up improved steering feel in All-Purpose and Sport modes and less steering wheel vibration with Universal Hands-Free.

The post 2026.41 first appeared on RivianTrackr.

item.title: What Should I Ask Rivian at Autonomy & AI Day?
item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
I'll be at Rivian's Autonomy & AI Day in Palo Alto on December 9 and want to bring your questions with me. Drop what you'd ask Rivian about Point to Point, hardware, or software in the comments.

The post What Should I Ask Rivian at Autonomy & AI Day? first appeared on RivianTrackr.

item.title: Rivian R2 Wins MotorTrend’s 2027 SUV of the Year
item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
MotorTrend has named the Rivian R2 its 2027 SUV of the Year, making Rivian the first startup to win with back-to-back products. The judges praised its range of abilities and its value, though the vents and halo controls still drew complaints.

The post Rivian R2 Wins MotorTrend’s 2027 SUV of the Year first appeared on RivianTrackr.

item.title: Rivian’s In-House Chip Is Going Into Mind Robotics’ Factory Robots
item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
RJ Scaringe says Rivian's in-house chip is being deployed in Mind Robotics' robots, which are headed to the Normal plant in mid-2027. It's the first time Rivian has confirmed the chip has a job outside its vehicles.

The post Rivian’s In-House Chip Is Going Into Mind Robotics’ Factory Robots first appeared on RivianTrackr.

item.title: Rivian 2026.41 Adding Alternative Routes, Spoken Alerts, and Custom Arrival Charge to R1 and R2
item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
Rivian's 2026.41 OTA brings alternative routes, spoken Waze and Google Maps alerts, and configurable arrival charge to both R1 and R2. Wassym Bensaid also confirmed negative SoC at arrival is part of the release.

The post Rivian 2026.41 Adding Alternative Routes, Spoken Alerts, and Custom Arrival Charge to R1 and R2 first appeared on RivianTrackr.

item.title: Point to Point Is Rivian’s Shot at Closing the Gap With Tesla FSD
item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
Rivian's Point to Point starts reaching early access owners in December, bringing address-to-address driving to Gen 2 R1 and R2. It's the closest Rivian has come to matching Tesla's FSD Supervised, and at half the monthly price.

The post Point to Point Is Rivian’s Shot at Closing the Gap With Tesla FSD first appeared on RivianTrackr.

item.title: Video: Rivian Replaced My R2 After Just 2 Months
item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
I picked up my replacement R2 on Friday, about a month after Rivian offered to swap my original so engineering could study its AC compressor failures. It's Launch Green again, this time with the Coastal Cloud interior and 21" all-season wheels.

The post Video: Rivian Replaced My R2 After Just 2 Months first appeared on RivianTrackr.

item.title: Tesla Is Ending Cybertruck Production, and the R1T Is Running Out of Rivals
item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production by mid-2027 to free up space for Cybercabs. With the F-150 Lightning already gone and GM pausing its next-gen trucks, the R1T suddenly has a lot less company.

The post Tesla Is Ending Cybertruck Production, and the R1T Is Running Out of Rivals first appeared on RivianTrackr.

item.title: Rivian Will Livestream Autonomy & AI Day on December 9 at 10 AM PT
item.dc:creator: Jose Castillo
item.description:
Rivian's second Autonomy & AI Day streams live on Rivian.com on December 9 starting at 10 a.m. PT. RJ, Wassym, James Philbin and Vidya Rajagopalan are speaking, and Point to Point should be the main event.

The post Rivian Will Livestream Autonomy & AI Day on December 9 at 10 AM PT first appeared on RivianTrackr.
